accepted.label: Sparse Bag-of-Words Vectors via Dictionary and doc2bow
accepted.description: Documents in Gensim are represented as sparse bag-of-words vectors, where each feature is a word count with zeros omitted. The Dictionary class maps words to integer IDs, and doc2bow converts tokenized documents into these vectors.
coverage_criteria: Explain what a Gensim sparse bag-of-words vector is.
Create a Dictionary from tokenized documents and use doc2bow to produce a sparse BOW vector.
accepted.merge_rationale: These two candidates describe the same subject concept: representing documents as sparse BOW vectors in Gensim. lr006_014 defines the vector format, and lr006_016 provides the mechanism to create it. They form one teachable idea about document vectorization.
